findings.finding: return_review_issue permits a succeeded source attempt and appends a newer queued attempt, while CanonicalTaorRunner marks a step completed if any historical attempt succeeded; the queued return can therefore be skipped.
the return command queues only the target stage, copies the previous input_refs unchanged, and does not compute or persist downstream invalidation, issue input, repair artifact or reuse decisions.
ReviewIssue validates Artifact, EvalReport and Evidence refs but persists rule_ref without resolving its exact revision and hash against a rule authority.

resolve accepts reason and resolution_refs but does not validate the refs or store a readable event payload; only payload_hash survives, so the resolution evidence cannot be reconstructed through the canonical API.
ReturnDecision is returned from the mutation and internally readable for idempotency replay, but no canonical get/list route, SDK read method or Review event timeline is exposed.
create, resolve and return routes require an authenticated principal but no explicit review or production-control permission gate is visible at the route or store boundary.
AIP lineage projects TaskRun and StepRun attempts, but does not include ReviewIssue, ReviewIssueEvent, ReturnDecision and their exact Eval or Evidence relations.

decisions: retain the existing AIP ReviewIssue, ReviewIssueEvent, ReturnDecision, StepRun and ArtifactRelation tables as the only authorities
change TAOR completion selection to latest-attempt semantics and add a regression where attempt 1 succeeded and attempt 2 is queued by return
compute an explicit invalidation set and reuse decisions from exact Artifact dependency relations before queuing the return attempt
new attempt inputs must include the exact issue, return decision, source artifact and selected repair or evidence refs rather than copying old inputs silently
resolve must validate resolution refs and persist a readable immutable resolution event payload or exact payload artifact ref
add canonical read APIs and strict SDK parsers for issue events and return decisions
extend lineage with ReviewIssue and ReturnDecision facts and stable cross-links to EvalReport, Evidence, Artifact, Stage attempt and replacement Artifact
fail closed on unresolved rule authority and unauthorized review commands
do not implement Workshop Review panels beyond read-only current facts until W4-03 and the P0 return execution gaps are closed

verification.interpretation: current tests prove append-only return and base TAOR behavior separately but do not cover the critical succeeded-attempt then queued-return integration path

nextGate: AIP must close latest-attempt dispatch, downstream invalidation, rule authority and auditable resolution lineage after W4-03 before Workshop W4-04 implementation can be authorized.
